name: mako-price-recorder
description: Mako Market price recorder: a Cloudflare Worker that records one-minute candles from Chainlink Data Streams for the charts (CHARTS_DS_PLAN). It never settles anything and shares no runtime state with the resolver.

scripts.bundle:spike: wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist-spike --name mako-price-recorder-spike src/bundle-spike.ts && node scripts/run-spike.mjs
